action.label: List issued onboarding links
action.description: List durable public-onboarding tokens that remain issued for office follow-up. Read-only projection; alters no handoff, delivery, or token state.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.label: Limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of issued links to return in one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.label: Cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a prior page.

action.label: Hand off customer
action.description: Finalize exactly one tracker-created Customer/Site against an EOM lead. Creates durable CRM state and requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Book estimate appointment
action.description: Book an estimate appointment for a lead without converting it to a customer. Creates a durable booking and calendar event, and requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Book first cleaning
action.description: Book the first cleaning for a lead: the lead becomes won and an onboarding email draft is enqueued for office approval. Nothing is sent. Creates durable CRM state and a calendar event, and requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Approve and send onboarding draft
action.description: Claim the pending onboarding draft, send it, and confirm delivery. The draft's status machine is the idempotency mechanism; an already-sent draft replays without a second send. This dispatches the onboarding email, so it requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Revoke issued onboarding link
action.description: Invalidate an issued customer onboarding link without changing sent-email evidence. Fences a still-live token when public issuance is disabled. Idempotent by the draft's link state: an already-revoked link replays without a second revocation, and a completed link cannot be revoked. Requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Recover public onboarding handoff
action.description: Complete a durable tracker reservation after an ambiguous public-onboarding finalization, using the stored token and customer/site ids rather than a raw bearer. Idempotent by the token reservation: a reservation already finalized for the same target replays, and one finalized for a different target conflicts. Requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Mark lead lost
action.description: Disposition a lead that will not convert with a reason code and optional note; it leaves the review queue. A won lead first cancels its persisted first-clean calendar event and revokes its unsent onboarding draft, so it is never reported lost after an uncertain teardown. Idempotent by the operation key. Requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Reopen lost lead
action.description: Return a previously-lost lead to its pre-loss active stage. Idempotent by the operation key; a lead that is not lost cannot be reopened. Requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Record missed call attempt
action.description: Record a real office no-answer for a lead; Atlas alone then decides whether a recovery mail sequence starts. Idempotent by the operation key. Requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Read missed call recovery status
action.description: Return bounded, non-PII recovery-sequence status for a set of leads already visible to the office. Read-only projection; alters no sequence, delivery, or lead state.

action.label: Resume missed call recovery
action.description: Explicitly resume one previously configuration-blocked recovery sequence. Idempotent by the operation key; a sequence that is not blocked cannot be resumed. Requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Cancel missed call recovery
action.description: Persist a verified stop condition (callback recorded, response recorded, opt out, or manual) for a recovery sequence without altering lead history. Idempotent by the operation key; a sequence that is not active cannot be cancelled. Requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Issue terms invitation
action.description: Issue and deliver one actor-audited terms invitation for an existing classified EOM customer. Idempotent by the request key; a contact that is not an active classified customer is refused. Sends the invitation email, so it requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Revoke terms invitation
action.description: Make one unaccepted terms invitation permanently unusable. An accepted invitation cannot be revoked. Requires a fresh operator approval.

action.label: Read terms readiness
action.description: Report whether the customer has current material terms evidence under the published version chain. Read-only projection; alters no invitation, delivery, or acceptance state.

action.label: Confirm terms delivery sent
action.description: Record an actor's external confirmation that an ambiguous terms delivery was sent, finalizing its terminal state. A pending delivery with no transport result cannot be confirmed. Requires a fresh operator approval.
